text:
Mira: Heads up — scheduling a pen-test for our Private infra (on‑prem + VPC) the week of May 2. Primary focus: KMS compromise scenarios, ephemeral RBAC, and audit-log completeness. Need access window + evidence plan by EOD Friday.

Ashley: +1. Can we scope to the serving runtime + keystore proxy only? avoids noisy infra/network layer scans.

Kevin: We should offer assessors a timeboxed read-only evidence bucket (presigned URLs) and a test role via our STS proxy. Avoid handing out long-lived creds.

Olivia: Oncall: we need a short runbook for live critical findings. Also confirm log retention policy — propose 90d for ops, 1y for legal. Sound OK?

Evan: For KMS, prep artifacts for key rotation proof, key policy snapshots, and wrapping key logs. Plan to deny Decrypt for assessor except through a dedicated test role.

Mira: Good. Assignments: Ashley — assessor role + intake pack, Kevin — provision bucket + KMS alias, Olivia — runbook, Evan — log export script. I'll sync with Legal on retention and signoff.

Ashley: Draft role policy (very tight) — snippet: ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:ListKeyPolicies","s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/*"}]}
``` Will put full doc in the intake form.

Kevin: Infra plan: will create alias `alias/pen-test-readonly`, CMK with explicit key policy allowing only `assessor-role` and `security-admin`. Key rotation off during window to make forensic timeline simpler. Bucket: `redwood-pt-evidence-staging` with 30d lifecycle, server-side encryption using the CMK.

Olivia: Runbook highlights: 1) Use #incidents for live escalations 2) Enable enhanced audit hooks pre-window 3) Snapshot telemetry (traces + metrics) on demand 4) If exploit active — trigger circuit breaker to pause traffic. I'll add play-by-play.

Mira: Retest plan question: assessors usually want a fast retest (after patch) and then a formal retest. Proposed slots: fast-retest ~72h after patch, formal retest ~14 days. Thoughts?

Ashley: Agree. Propose reserving two slots: May 10 (72h) and May 16 (formal). Keep calendar tentatively blocked.

Evan: We also need signed log bundles for auditors. I'll script an export that zips CloudTrail + Keystore proxy logs and produces sha256 checksums. Example command I plan to provide: `tar czf logs.tar.gz cloudtrail/ keystore/ && sha256sum logs.tar.gz > logs.tar.gz.sha256`

pt-bot: Reminder: Please submit the completed intake form before roles are provisioned: https://pt.intake/form/xyz :spiral_note_pad:

Mira: Action items recap: Ashley — role doc + intake pack (due Thu EOD). Kevin — bucket + alias (due Fri AM). Evan — log export script sample (due Fri). Olivia — runbook draft (due Thu). I'll follow up with Legal on retention. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:

Ashley: ack, will share draft link shortly.

Kevin: ack, starting infra tickets now.

Olivia: will drop runbook PR later today.

Evan: posting initial script to the intake doc by EOD.

Mira: Thanks team — please keep updates minimal here to avoid noisy thread. If a critical issue arises during the window, escalate to #incidents and call the bridge.
